description: Manages Github repositories using PyGithub library.

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: Token parameter for authentication. This is only needed when not using username and password.

parameters.name: api_url
parameters.description: URL to the GitHub API if not using github.com but you own instance. Default: "https://api.github.com"

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Description for the repository. Defaults to empty if force_defaults=true, which is the default in this module. Defaults to empty if force_defaults=false when creating a new repository. This is only used when state is present.

parameters.name: force_defaults
parameters.description: If true, overwrite current description and private attributes with defaults. true is deprecated for this option and will not be allowed starting in community.general 13.0.0. false will be the default value then. Choices: false true

parameters.name: organization
parameters.description: Organization for the repository. When state=present, the repository is created in the current user profile.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Password used for authentication. This is only needed when not using access_token.

parameters.name: private
parameters.description: Whether the repository should be private or not. Defaults to false if force_defaults=true, which is the default in this module. Defaults to false if force_defaults=false when creating a new repository. This is only used when state=present. Choices: false true

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Whether the repository should exist or not. Choices: "absent" "present" ← (default)

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: Username used for authentication. This is only needed when not using access_token.

examples:
- name: Create a Github repository
  community.general.github_repo:
    access_token: mytoken
    organization: MyOrganization
    name: myrepo
    description: "Just for fun"
    private: true
    state: present
    force_defaults: false
  register: result

- name: Delete the repository
  community.general.github_repo:
    username: octocat
    password: password
    organization: MyOrganization
    name: myrepo
    state: absent
  register: result

return_values.name: repo
return_values.description: Repository information as JSON. See https://docs.github.com/en/rest/reference/repos#get-a-repository. Returned: success and state=present
